verses.text: For the music director, with stringed instruments. A psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God who upholds my cause. Give me room to breathe in my distress. Have mercy and hear my prayer.
People, how long will you turn my honor into shame? How long will you love empty things and chase lies? Selah.
Know that the LORD has set apart the faithful for himself. The LORD hears when I call to him.
Tremble with awe and don’t sin. When you lie down, search your heart and be still. Selah.
Offer sacrifices that are right, and put your trust in the LORD.
Many ask, “Who will show us anything good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
You’ve given me more joy than they have when their grain and fresh wine are plentiful.
I’ll lie down and sleep in peace, because you alone, LORD, keep me safe.
